title: pseudonymize institute names in demo mode
body:
Names of institutes can be considered as personally identifiable information, especially in courses where all users come from different institutes. Therefore we should add the following pseudonimizations in demo mode:

- institute names
- email domain names
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Domain name is always set to `dodona.ugent.be`.
